title: The flats, absent
logline: The flats at low tide with no one on them and no prints — the first spring the strip's walk isn't drawn. The channels, the chimney, the gulls. The page is the walk not taken.

panels.composition: Wide mudflats at low tide with no figures and no prints, channels catching a gray sky, gulls, the chimney far across the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, wide tidal mudflats at low tide with no figures and no prints, channels catching a gray sky, gulls and a distant chimney across the bay, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: No prints. The walk not taken.
